about: Every monster, player and pet on 24 frames of Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North II (map 10002073) at the game's own 1366x768, saved losslessly in game on 2026-10-28 at 19:17:54-19:19:43 (the frames are the test data set tree_dungeon_native, in gamelab/lab/testdata/tree_dungeon_native, git-ignored like the rest of the lab, not in git: tests/testdata.py): td_p<platform>_<i>.png, 3 frames about 2 s apart with her on each of platforms 13, 16, 18, 20, 21, 23, 25 and 30 (the td_p24 ones named for 24, where she stood as the capture began: she dropped onto 25 as it did, landing on td_p24_0; a frame shows the game up to about 1.5 s before its file's time, td_p24_0 0.86 s by the perception service's looks), on a crowded channel (Fidelio, Kalusmi, Nodx, Yellowish, Arkangel, Momette, CLOUDENVY, MadAngryDawn, Jezhan and their pets about her, attacking the same monsters: damage numbers, skills and hit sparks over many of them). Labelled 2026-10-28 by eye on 2x gridded tiles of each frame's play area and 4-8x gridded zooms of every object (the perception service's scene records of those seconds, 20261028-181611-perceive.jsonl, taken as a starting hint only: its nearest record had 22 of the 88 monsters shown here that aren't fading or mostly cut within 12 px, 29 within 25), then checked by: each kind's sprites fitted around each label (every stand, move, hit1 and die1 frame of the three kinds, both ways, masked TM_CCOEFF_NORMED on their opaque pixels within the frame and above the chat bar; where something is in front, scored leaving it out; a frozen one channel by channel), the footholds (screen = map + camera, the camera's x and its y from the service's view, the y refitted so the best-fitted monsters' feet lie on their footholds: every monster's feet then within 2.5 px of one), a whole-frame sprite search down to 0.5, a scan for a mushroom body's exact colours outside the labels (each such blob found to be a player, a pet, a tag or her), the map's monster detector (sprites.detector_for at NATIVE, detect_wide over rows 0-700: all of its 71 finds are labelled) and its loot detector (no drop found on any frame; none seen by eye either: there is no drops file). Format as tree_dungeon_monsters.json: a monster's x, y are its feet (its sprite's origin; +-1 px where its fit is 0.95 or more, +-3 px where it's partly hidden, by eye where no frame fits), facing 1 right, -1 left, 0 not told; state normal, hit (its flinch frame), spawning (fading in), dying (a die1 frame; the last fades to a cap in a bubble) or frozen (tinted blue by a player's ice skill, its pose otherwise as drawn); hidden true where something covers part of it (hidden_by says what: a player, a pet, a tag, a skill, a damage number, the portal's light, the top edge or the chat bar) and for every spawning or dying one; visible_rows, its picture's share inside the frame and above the chat bar (row 700); frame and fit, the frame of its kind's sprites that fits it best within 2 px and that fit's plain score ('' where none fits or the fit can't tell the facing; for a frozen one fit_tint is the channel-by-channel score); certain false where its kind can't be told from what shows (a body cut by the top edge: the mushrooms' bodies are the same picture) and is its platform's (platform: the foothold its feet are on; this map's platforms each spawn one kind, and a monster keeps to its platform), or where the picture is too covered to tell; note says what else was seen. her: her feet, her name tag's centre less 11 rows (her_tag, by the 1366x768 tag template; on td_p21_1 and td_p21_2, where damage numbers cover it, by eye). her_platform: the platform under her feet (within 2 of its surface; null on td_p24_0, where she's in the air: her_note), added 2026-10-28 from the map's footholds and checked against the perception service's looks of those seconds. Players and pets: feet and tag (a tag's centre: its text's middle across, its capitals' top + 5 down; null where hidden), the feet the tag less 11 rows (standing ones' tags are 9-10 rows under their foothold), else read by eye (on the foothold under them where only a head shows above the chat bar); a player's name from his tag, name_from 'look' where it's hidden and his look is that of a player named in another frame, null where neither tells; a pet's owner 'her', a player's name (whose pet it follows in these frames), or null. Pets here: her orange Snail, other players' Snails, Fidelio's White Bunny, Arkangel's White Bunny named Psalms (in a helmet) and Kalusmi's Black Pig. None of them is a monster. other: what else is on the frame and isn't labelled. camera: map_to_screen as used for the platforms.
